rule: Unreconciled carried 2025 provisions require a legal-chain hold
short_quote: sont d’application dans le cadre de la présente Loi
reviewer_note: Actual carry-forward list makes missing original 24/011 reconciliation a valid hold.

rule: Original law begins 1 January 2026; rectifier begins on 7 August 2026 promulgation; unchanged original provisions saved
short_quote: La présente Loi entre en vigueur à la date de sa promulgation.
reviewer_note: Original 1 January commencement and rectifier promulgation/unchanged-law savings confirmed.

rule: Independent habitual/occasional taxable activity; public service exclusion depends on competition
short_quote: lorsque leur nonassujettissement n’entraîne pas de distorsions dans les conditions de la concurrence
reviewer_note: Public-service exclusion depends on distortion of competition; no blanket immunity asserted.

rule: Inclusive annual 80 million CDF threshold; liberal professions regardless of turnover
short_quote: égal ou supérieur à 80.000.000 de Francs congolais
reviewer_note: Inclusive threshold and professional exception accurately reproduced as cited historical baseline.

rule: Express below-threshold option under regulatory modalities, definitive two years unless revoked
short_quote: Elle est définitive pendant deux ans suivant l’exercice de l’option
reviewer_note: Express request, two-year option and administrative revocation all retained.

rule: Existing status persists following two years after turnover falls; minister can change threshold
short_quote: celui-ci conserve sa qualité les deux années suivant celle de la constatation de la diminution du chiffre d’affaires
reviewer_note: Two following years retained; ministerial adjustment power prevents automatic currentness claim.

rule: Ordinary 16% outside reduced/zero categories in both enacted schedules
short_quote: 16% applicable à toutes les opérations imposables
reviewer_note: 16% excludes reduced/zero operations in each text.

rule: Tariff 1006.20.00 brown rice 1% original; 8% rectifier acquisitions/sales
short_quote: Riz décortiqué (riz cargo ou riz brun)
reviewer_note: 1006.20.00 is 1% original and 8% rectifier; acquisition/sale scope retained.

rule: Domestic air ticket 5% both schedules
short_quote: à la vente des billets d’avion sur le trafic aérien national, soit 5%
reviewer_note: National air-ticket sales remain 5% in both versions.

rule: Original local-cement inputs 1%; rectifier enumerated inputs and sale wording 5%
short_quote: pièces de rechange destinées aux équipements de production du ciment et à la vente, soit 5%
reviewer_note: Cement acquisition category changes 1% to enumerated 5%; anomalous sale wording not silently resolved.

rule: Original agro-industry raw/input 1% bullet not reproduced in rectifier; no carry-forward conclusion
short_quote: produits agricoles bruts et intrants destinés à l’agro-industrie
reviewer_note: Original agro-industry bullet absent from complete August replacement; no invented continuation.

rule: Listed local industrial-metal acquisitions 1%; rectifier adds tantalum and amended item scope
short_quote: aux acquisitions locales des matières premières pour la valorisation de l’industrie locale
reviewer_note: Original metals list does not expressly say local acquisitions; joint Guide row and ledger12 incorrectly carry August local-acquisition scope into original version. Retain original local-industry purpose and distinguish August local acquisitions.
additional_original_quote: aux matières premières pour la valorisation de l’industrie locale

rule: Palm-refining inputs 1% require ministerial list; locally produced refined oil 1%
short_quote: dont la liste sera déterminée par Arrêté du Ministre ayant les Finances dans ses attributions
reviewer_note: Palm-input list delegated to order; local refined-oil sale category separately present.

rule: National-interest public infrastructure construction category 1%
short_quote: projets publics d’infrastructures d’intérêt national, soit 1%

rule: Reduced 1% benefit conditional on acquisition-quota mechanism; implementation order required
short_quote: est subordonné à un mécanisme de contingentement des acquisitions de biens et services éligibles
reviewer_note: August 1% benefit expressly depends on quota mechanism and ministerial implementation.

rule: Exports and assimilated operations 0%; foreign customer alone insufficient
short_quote: taux 0%, applicable aux exportations et opérations assimilées
reviewer_note: Zero category exports and assimilated operations; foreign customer alone is not statutory classification.

rule: Read actual product/code tables; rectifier anomalies not silently repaired
short_quote: Les taux de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée sont les suivants
reviewer_note: Actual numbering/code anomalies observed; Guide correctly requires direct table classification.

rule: Goods ownership-disposal definition; exchanges/contributions/hirepurchase/disposals/exports included
short_quote: un transfert du pouvoir de disposer de ce bien comme propriétaire
reviewer_note: Transfer-of-owner-disposal and non-exhaustive named goods operations confirmed.

rule: Services are other-than-tangible-goods deliveries; specified rental/professional/telecom/construction operations
short_quote: toutes les opérations autres que les livraisons de biens meubles corporels
reviewer_note: Other-than-tangible-delivery service definition and named activity types confirmed.

rule: Self-produced fixed assets include own tangible/intangible production with or without third parties
short_quote: avec ou sans le concours de tiers
reviewer_note: Own tangible/intangible fixed-asset production includes third-party assistance.

rule: Article 28 addition includes applicable taxes/duties/excises excluding VAT; complete valuation/tax-point chain held
short_quote: y compris les droits d’accises, applicables aux produits ou aux services, à l’exclusion de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée elle-même
reviewer_note: Added tax/duty/excise base rule excludes VAT itself; broader valuation held.

rule: Net output minus eligible input VAT, not automatic cost recovery
short_quote: verser au Trésor la différence entre la TVA qu’elle a collectée et celle qu’elle a déduite
reviewer_note: Authority describes collected less deductible VAT; Guide retains eligibility qualifications.

rule: Proper taxable-supplier invoice/equivalent needs tax number; foreign supplier exception with regulated liquidation
short_quote: en ce qui concerne les factures émises par les prestataires étrangers, cette condition n’est pas exigée
reviewer_note: Article 38 supplier invoice/tax-number condition and foreign-provider exception retained.

rule: Import customs consumption declaration and self-invoice evidence
short_quote: sur la déclaration de mise à la consommation établie par la douane
reviewer_note: Customs consumption declaration and self-invoice evidence distinguished.

rule: Final export-related deductions require customs evidence of actual export
short_quote: l’effectivité de l’exportation est établie par les documents douaniers
reviewer_note: Export effectiveness requires customs documents for final deduction.

rule: Article 41 lists expense/use exclusions with professional/use exceptions; no blanket deduction
short_quote: N’ouvre pas droit à déduction, la taxe ayant grevé
reviewer_note: Expense exclusions have professional/use exceptions; Guide screens full exclusion list and holds currentness.

rule: Article 42 passenger-vehicle/transport exclusions with enumerated exceptions
short_quote: Toutefois, l’exclusion visée ci-dessus ne concerne pas
reviewer_note: Passenger-vehicle/transport exclusions and express exceptions read; no blanket deduction given.

rule: Unfindable supplier or invoice address excludes input VAT
short_quote: une facture dont l’adresse renseignée est introuvable
reviewer_note: Unfindable supplier/notified address and unfindable invoice address are alternative denial limbs.

rule: Duplicate invoice/customs-declaration deduction receives article 74 sanction; amount held
short_quote: plus d’une fois pour la déduction de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée
reviewer_note: Duplicate invoice/customs deduction sanction added; numerical sanction not invented.

rule: Historical at-least 1 million CDF transaction between taxable persons requires cheque/transfer/card; minister can change
short_quote: doit être payée par chèque, par virement ou par carte bancaire
reviewer_note: Historical bank-payment requirement is at least 1m and between VAT taxable persons; adjustment power retained.

rule: Breach of historical bank-payment condition loses input deduction; current chain held
short_quote: la perte du droit à déduction de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée supportée
reviewer_note: Breach loses supported input deduction under historical text; current chain expressly held.

rule: Refund has request/claimant/investment/timing/limit conditions; no automatic cash-refund entitlement
short_quote: sur demande expresse adressée à l’Administration des impôts
reviewer_note: Refund request, claimant classes, investment and time/amount limits read; Guide grants no automatic refund.

rule: Monthly prescribed return by 15 thnextmonth in duplicate with payment, including nil and self-supplies
short_quote: La déclaration doit être souscrite même si aucune opération imposable n’a été réalisée
reviewer_note: Monthly following-15th, duplicate, payment, nil and self-supply requirements confirmed.

rule: Ordinary import VAT declared/paid before removal
short_quote: avant l’enlèvement de la marchandise
reviewer_note: Import declaration/payment before removal confirmed as historical text.

rule: Mining import/local manufactured special mechanism excludes petroleum and needs ministerial modalities
short_quote: à l’exception des produits pétroliers
reviewer_note: Mining import/local manufactured goods mechanism excludes petroleum and requires implementation order.

rule: Public form/resource labels do not establish authenticated submission/receipt
short_quote: Nouveau modèle officiel de formulaire de déclaration de la TVA
reviewer_note: Public resource labels are present; neither login nor successful filing claimed.

rule: Registration fine historical article 69 read but current amount and consolidated tax penalties held
short_quote: L’absence de déclaration d’assujettissement auprès de l’Administration des impôts dans le délai est sanctionnée
reviewer_note: Historical registration fine exists; Guide deliberately withholds current amount/consolidated penalties.

rule: Current CNSS replaced INSS; authority identifies the institution.
short_quote: remplacer l’ancien Institut National de Sécurité Sociale
reviewer_note: Institutional source says CNSS replaced former INSS; historical page date typo does not affect naming conclusion.

rule: Ordinary principal work in DR Congo without nationality distinction; additional named categories.
short_quote: sans aucune distinction de race, de nationalité
reviewer_note: Ordinary principal-national-work and nationality-independent scope confirmed; special categories not flattened.

rule: Specified apprentices and trainees have risk-only coverage; full-branch status is not automatic.
short_quote: pour la branche des risques professionnels
reviewer_note: Risk-only article 4 categories distinguished from article 3 full-branch scope and article 5 optional scope.

rule: Direction, authority and employment facts determine worker status; an employer uses one or more workers.
short_quote: sous la direction et l’autorité d’une personne physique ou morale
reviewer_note: Direction/authority and employment relationship confirmed; employer may use one or more workers.

rule: Family branch: 6.5%, employer only.
short_quote: fixé à 6,5 %, à charge exclusive de l’employeur
reviewer_note: 6.5% family contribution entirely employer borne.

rule: Pension branch: 10%, split 5% employer and 5% worker.
short_quote: 5% à charge de l’employeur
reviewer_note: 10% pension split equally 5% employer/worker.

rule: Ordinary risks: 1.5%, employer only; up to double for noncompliance; separate special-risk instrument.
short_quote: fixé à 1,5% à charge exclusive de l’employeur
reviewer_note: 1.5% ordinary risks, doubling for noncompliance and separate high-risk-rate power retained.

rule: Ordinary derived employer 13%, worker 5%, total 18%, only for the stated full-branch facts.
short_quote: appliqués aux personnes assujetties à tout ou partie du régime général de la sécurité sociale
reviewer_note: Derived employer 13%, employee 5%, total 18% arithmetic valid only stated ordinary full-branch facts.

rule: Pension and family rates deferred to 1 January 2019; historical transition and decree commencement read.
short_quote: est différée au 1er janvier 2019
reviewer_note: Pension/family deferral to 1 January 2019 and decree signature commencement confirmed.

rule: Contribution base cannot fall below guaranteed minimum; current amount and cap remain unproved.
short_quote: ne peut être inférieur au salaire minimum interprofessionnel garanti
reviewer_note: Minimum base floor confirmed; current minimum/cap not inferred from historical text.

rule: CNSS base includes listed remuneration gains, overtime, benefits, holiday and incapacity/maternity pay.
short_quote: l’ensemble des gains susceptibles d’être évalués en espèces
reviewer_note: Salary/commission/bonus/overtime/in-kind/holiday/incapacity and maternity components confirmed.

rule: CNSS base excludes healthcare, housing, legal family allowances, transport, travel and exclusively duty-facilitating benefits.
short_quote: Ne sont pas éléments de la rémunération
reviewer_note: Healthcare, housing, legal family, transport, travel and exclusively duty-facilitating benefits excluded.

rule: Specified assimilated-worker base differs; includes listed emoluments, benefits and attendance fees.
short_quote: l’ensemble des rétributions perçues en contre partie de ses prestations
reviewer_note: Article 17(2) special base specifically concerns article 3(2),(4),(6); Guide flags specified category rather than all workers.

rule: Employer applies branch rates to supported remuneration for monthly service, paid leave and other legally remunerated periods.
short_quote: une période de service effectif, une période de congés rémunérés
reviewer_note: Rates applied to supported remuneration for service, paid leave and other legally payable periods.

rule: Employer owes all contributions and missed deductions; cannot recover an omitted worker deduction later.
short_quote: Il ne peut en aucun cas les récupérer auprès du travailleur
reviewer_note: Employer owes whole remittance and bears missed deductions; retrospective recovery from worker prohibited.

rule: Employer contribution is exclusively its charge; successive employers account for their remuneration proportionately.
short_quote: La cotisation de l’employeur reste exclusivement et définitivement à sa charge
reviewer_note: Employer share definitively its charge; successive employers proportionate to remuneration paid.

rule: IRPP monthly withholding uses salary net base and references annual scale; monthly implementation held; art.126 requires ministerial collection/remittance modalities.
short_quote: est retenu mensuellement par l’employeur pour le compte du Trésor public

rule: Domestic and microenterprise employee withholding finality requires sole income; no ordinary annual finality assumed.
short_quote: pour autant que ces rémunérations constituent pour eux des revenus uniques
quote_match: visually confirmed PDF40; OCR peur/pour error
reviewer_note: Domestic/microenterprise finality requires sole income; visual scan confirms quote despite OCR peur/pour error. Ledger art.70 locator must include PDF29 beginning, not only PDF30 continuation.

rule: Expatriate levy is an employer charge: 25% of gross article 68 pay with salary exemptions; payment/availability trigger.
short_quote: 25%du montant brut des rémunérations
reviewer_note: Enterprise-employer expatriate levy: qualifying gross art.68 pay, salary exemptions/immunities, 25%, payment/availability trigger.

rule: Monthly declaration within 15 days following month; unique form for business creators, others Model DC in triplicate.
short_quote: une déclaration de versement des cotisations sera remplie en trois exemplaires

rule: Declaration identification, period, pay/base, branches and payment fields; payroll sheets attached.

rule: More than 25 workers electronic with receipt; fewer than 25 electronic or paper; exactly 25 wording gap.
short_quote: plus de vingt-cinq travailleurs

rule: No-worker report within 15 days; centralised declaration details each centre; missing annexes equals no declaration.

rule: CNSS account credited within 15 days following month; five-day regularisation does not move original deadline.

reviewer_note: Account must be credited within15 days; five-day regularisation and 21st penalty start do not replace due date.

rule: Salary withholding remitted by fifteenth following payment/availability month; managing-service declaration including nil.

rule: Expatriate levy remitted within 15 days following payment/availability month; managing-service declaration including nil.

short_quote: au plus tard le 31 mars de chaque année

rule: Tax sanctions follow amended fiscal Procedures Law; CNSS rates cannot be borrowed.

rule: Carried 2025 tax provisions remain unreconciled; historical social collection is not an exhaustive 2026 consolidation.
